cap: Several normal changes of pregnancy look abnormal outside it. Filtration rises about 50 percent, so creatinine falls and 1.0 mg/dL already suggests reduced function, and filtered glucose can exceed reabsorption. Progesterone and uterine compression dilate the ureters, which favors pyelonephritis. The placenta raises alkaline phosphatase, estrogen raises thyroxine-binding globulin, hCG can lower TSH, and relaxin loosens the pelvic ligaments.
